text:
Maya (CS): Heads up team: MedLink (telemed) emailed requesting onboarding of a customer-finetuned 13B summarizer under Private deployment. Core asks: PHI-safe, HSM for keys, VPC-only control plane, and they want a pre-renewal hallucination/regression eval. Can someone own infra/security?

Oliver (AM): Ill coordinate with procurement on the DPA and confirm the renewal window. Customer is price-sensitive; prefer A10Gs if perf OK.

Raj (ML Eng): 13B w/ 512-token summaries at p95 160ms would be challenging on A10G. Need to profile. Ask them for: model artifact (HF or ONNX), tokenizer, and a representative prompt corpus. Also request a small local latency trace.

Priya (Solutions): I'll send a short onboarding checklist to the customer with those artifact asks and a template for the privacy/dataflow diagram.

Lina (Security): HSM & VPC only are supported. We need: 1) DPA signed, 2) dataflow diagram, 3) retention & logging preferences, 4) list of external integrations (EHR, SFTP). If they require zero logs, we'll need an exception for auditability.

Maya (CS): Can someone provision a short Dedicated eval window for profiling? Prefer to try A10G first and escalate to A100 if needed.

OnboardBot: Intake ticket created: CS-2026-4907. Assigned: Maya, Raj, Lina, Priya. Provisioning ETA set to 1768905000.

Raj (ML Eng): To expedite, ask them to run this sample curl against a staging endpoint and paste the response times:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.medlink.example/run -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"docs":["<doc1>","<doc2>","<doc3>"],"max_tokens":512}' -w '\nTime_namelookup:%{time_namelookup}\nTime_connect:%{time_connect}\nTime_starttransfer:%{time_starttransfer}\nTime_total:%{time_total}\n'
```
This helps us estimate tokenization and client-side latency.

Priya (Solutions): Also confirm whether they do client-side de-identification before sending or expect us to handle de-id. That affects the eval scope.

Lina (Security): If they want us to process raw PHI, we'll require an HSM-backed key policy and SOC2/HIPAA questionnaire answers. I'll draft the checklist.

Maya (CS): Action list: Priya send checklist to MedLink today; Raj to prepare perf matrix (A10G vs A100 vs quantized 13B) in 3bd; Lina to draft security/HSM steps in 3bd; Ill schedule a kickoff once artifacts arrive. Marking renewal-risk as "monitoring" until eval clears.

Oliver (AM): I'll loop in finance for cost estimates based on Raj's matrix.

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone. I'll post the intake doc link here once I get artifacts from MedLink. :wave:
